title: The WalkUp: a concept site for the bar upstairs
tag: Concept site · cocktail bar, Cary, NC
summaryLead: A concept site for the cocktail bar one flight up in downtown Cary. Our own idea, not a launched project.
story: The WalkUp is a cocktail bar one flight up in downtown Cary, above happy's. People walk past the door because they don't know it's there. This concept turns that into the page. A 14-step gold meter fills as you scroll from the street up to Suite 200. It's dark and warm, set entirely in Lekton, a mono face, so it reads like a typed menu.
goals: Tell first-timers the bar is upstairs.
Make the menu easy to plan a round from.

features.title: Scroll staircase
features.text: A 14-step gold meter fills as you scroll from the street to Suite 200.
features.story: People miss the door, so the climb is the navigation. The steps drop in one at a time, 110 milliseconds apart, and the meter tells you where you are on the way up.

features.title: Menu and running tab
features.text: 49 items in tabs, five specialty cocktail cards, and a tab that stays on the page.
features.story: The menu changes with the season and guests order at the counter, so there's no cart. Tapping an item adds it to a running tab, just a tally for planning a round.

features.title: Vector logo and hero
features.text: The gold script logo, redrawn as vector art for the nav, hero and footer.
features.alt: The WalkUp hero with the gold script logo
features.story: The only logo file was a small image that went blurry when stretched. We traced it into vector paths, so it stays sharp at any size.

features.title: The room
features.text: The exposed-brick lounge, with the staircase meter alongside.
features.story: The hero fades up from black, like the lights coming up. The menu is framed in printed-menu brackets.

features.title: Reviews
features.text: Guest quotes on a dark blue block, against the cream menu.

features.title: Visit
features.text: Address, hours, seating and an email sign-up.
